info.title: WIRE API
info.description:
REST API for wire transfer intent management, approvals, voice challenges, audit bundles, API keys, and webhooks.

This API provides:
- Transfer intent lifecycle (create, update, execute)
- Voice challenge and proof submission
- Approval decisions and token management
- Beneficiary management
- Policy configuration and simulation
- Event chain and audit bundle generation
- API keys and webhooks (developer platform)

All endpoints are prefixed with `/api/wire`.

**Authentication:**
- UI sessions: `Authorization: Bearer <token>`
- Integrations: `Authorization: Basic base64(<apiKey>:<apiSecret>)` (recommended) or `X-API-KEY: <apiKey>` (legacy)

**Error Format:** All errors follow `{ error: string, code?: string, details?: object }` format.
**Idempotency:** Mutating endpoints support `X-Idempotency-Key` (where applicable).

tags.name: Webhooks
tags.description: Webhook configuration, delivery logs, testing, and rotation

get.description: Returns the health status of dependent services (voice, phone, storage).
Returns all transfer intents for the authenticated user's organization, ordered by creation date (newest first).

post.description: Creates a new transfer intent. Requires `intent:create` permission.

404.description: Beneficiary not found or policy not configured

get.description: Returns a specific transfer intent by ID. Must belong to the authenticated user's organization.

patch.description: Updates a transfer intent. Requires `intent:create` permission. Updates to binding-critical fields will invalidate approvals and tokens.

400.description: Invalid request body or empty patch

post.description: Creates a voice challenge for a transfer intent. Returns challenge text and expected slots for voice verification.
Submits a voice proof for a challenge. Returns verification scores and proof metadata.
Creates an approval decision (APPROVE, DENY, or STEP_UP) for a transfer intent. Requires `intent:approve` permission. Returns an approval token if threshold is met and decision is APPROVE.
Executes a transfer intent using an approval token. Requires `intent:execute` permission. The approval token must be provided in the `X-POSE-APPROVAL` header.

400.description: Missing X-POSE-APPROVAL header or invalid token

get.description: Returns the event chain for a transfer intent, ordered by sequence number.

post.description: Generates an audit bundle for a transfer intent. Requires `intent:view_bundle` permission. The bundle includes a signed manifest of all intent data, events, and proofs.

get.description: Returns all beneficiaries for the authenticated user's organization.

post.description: Creates a new beneficiary. Requires `beneficiary:create` permission.

get.description: Returns the active policy version for the authenticated user's organization.

post.description: Creates a new policy version. Requires `policy:edit` permission.
Simulates risk scoring for a transfer configuration without creating an intent.

404.description: Beneficiary not found or no policy configured

get.description: Lists API keys for the authenticated organization. Requires `api:view` permission.

post.description: Creates a new API key. Returns `secret` only once. Requires `api:create` permission.
Revokes an API key. Requires `api:edit` permission.

delete.description: Deletes an API key. Requires `api:delete` permission.

get.description: Lists webhooks for the authenticated organization. Requires `webhook:view` permission.

post.description: Creates a webhook and returns `secret` only once. Requires `webhook:create` permission.

get.description: Lists recent delivery attempts for a webhook (delivery logs). Requires `webhook:view` permission.

post.description: Queues a test delivery to the webhook target. Requires `webhook:edit` permission.
Rotates webhook signing secret and returns the new secret once. Requires `webhook:edit` permission.
